A_scoring.margin_status: Prospective design conventions, not estimates of power or thresholds learned from prior exposed results
A_scoring.missing_failed_arm: No utility pass or A scoring; retain every failure and cost. No replacement arm/seed or shortened H.
A_scoring.population: All A nodes, all classes, all four members; before/after common initial and each endpoint; no winner subgroup
A_scoring.primary: Full-A pool accuracy, NLL, Brier; complete per-member same metrics
A_scoring.unsupported_class_summary: Retain denominators and undefined summaries; do not drop unsupported cells
A_scoring.when: Only after common400 and all six exact H16 states are immutable and all seven complete native served predictions exist. A labels are excluded from fitting/selection and opened by the separate final evaluator then; compact-source custodian projection necessarily decodes A earlier without predictive use.

affinity.K: K_ij=1 iff native public undirected graph has edge(i,j) for distinct i,j in S; symmetric, zero diagonal, no labels or learned weights in primary K
affinity.items: Every S node and all C-1 non-target competitors; all ten unordered class pairs contain both true-label directions
affinity.pair_map: G0 restriction K_p; W_p=K_p/(1+max row_sum(K_p)); L_p=diag(W_p1)-W_p. Same-label and cross-label edges retained.
affinity.permutation: One global permutation of S within each true class using sha256(amazon-response-G0|split=0|seed=17|perm|<class>|<node_id>) order; map the increasing node-ID order of each class onto its hash order. Set K_perm=P K P^T. Native graph/model forwards unchanged.
affinity.permutation_scope: Uses only S labels to preserve every true-class/competitor stratum; no A or R labels, no choice among permutations

arms.purpose: Measured private learning response plus aligned graph responsibilities and live outer Q credit
Same paid probe/solver; Q=1/4 makes extra margin loss ordinary uniform margin supervision
Current margin costs rather than measured response; identical normalization/balance/graph map
gamma=0 only; balance still couples items, so this is not claimed fully separable
Single class/competitor-preserving graph-responsibility permutation; same native serving graph
Remove only Q chain in outer credit; same forward response at identical states, not necessarily later trajectories

budget.feasibility_stop: Before final A evaluator opens labels, stop for failed native derivative/runtime/resource support or failed/missing arm. No smaller graph, frozen features, truncated derivatives, replacement seed, shortened H or empirical scale rescue.
budget.run_layout: One common acquisition and six serial continuations. Keep only one active clone on device; charge all acquisition, virtual/probe/recomputed, backward, solver and endpoint costs.

continuation.core_update: One G0 SGD theta update on own/pool outerR objective; no Adam state in continuation
continuation.history_derivatives: Committed state detached between episodes, exactly as G0; no full-H meta-gradient
continuation.mode: eval-mode dropout off, but gradients enabled and all active shared/private trainable tensors updated
continuation.ownership: theta: all genuinely shared variables; phi_m: complete row m of stem/local_head/global_head R/S/B. Q independent in private partial, live in outer total theta derivative except stop_q.
continuation.private_commit: Recompute preliminary probe, normalized response costs, Q and main private response at theta+ from original phi; commit that response; discard virtual states
continuation.stage: Global throughout, retaining complete ten-local-layer plus one-global-layer native forward

data.preprocessing: Pinned native raw features; to_undirected, remove_self_loops, add_self_loops. No graph view, feature normalization or label propagation.

initial_response_diagnostic.departure_from_prefit_review_ideal: Does not reuse transformed first-episode tensors; explicitly counted extra computation avoids closure-side effects or an unqualified has_aux orchestration
initial_response_diagnostic.method: Explicit extra exact G0V2 private_response call using fixed S and prepared sparse pairs, virtual states discarded; separate disabled helper, no core/private commit
retain: Q relative RMS and max movement from1/4

initialization.acquisition_loss: Mean of all four member own CE on W only; S/R label values absent from the acquisition loader, losses and selection
initialization.construction: Seed all source RNGs; fresh native constructor/device reset; one boundary wrap; stem R Rademacher, other R=1, all S=1, private B copied native bias. Never reset after wrapping.
initialization.forbidden_initial_states: All old trained/VALID-selected/all-TRAIN states, fitted hidden banks, cached trained embeddings, old selectors or optimizer states
initialization.optimizer: Native Adam lr=0.001, weight_decay=0, default betas/eps; no scheduler/clipping/AMP
initialization.recipe_status: Prospectively fixed local200/global200 W-only gate acquisition, distinct from both V1 all-B warming and the original200+2500/VALID-selected study
initialization.stage_transition: After local update200 set core._global=True and continue current weights/Adam/RNG. No selection, checkpoint rollback or local-best restore.
initialization.state_for_contrast: Last state after update400, shared once by exact clones of all six arms; no A/VALID selector

later_if_passes: Only consider one frozen prospective comparison against capable same-forward all-branch direct-pool/ordinary own+pool training, a competent nonlinear single, separately trained independent4, and same-operation untied4. Exact same-operator all-branch relabeling is an equality sanity check, not a distinct baseline to beat.

roles.A: Unchanged V1 A identity: first floor(N_TRAIN/5) nodes of A hash order; evaluator labels excluded from every W/S/R loss and selector
roles.W: First floor(|B|/2) ordered nodes; the only label supervision in common acquisition
roles.derive_from: Official split0 TRAIN node IDs/mask only; no labels for role derivation
roles.initially_label_unseen_S_R: Loss/selection exposure only; full public graph/features remain transductive and custodian decodes their source labels during projection
roles.innerS: Next floor(|B|/4) ordered nodes; first used for private/probe supervision after common state freezes; fixed in all arms/episodes
roles.missing_class_in_S: Record the failed qualification; do not drop a class or reseed
roles.outerR: Every remaining B node; first used for outer own/pool supervision after common state freezes; repeatedly trains theta, not held evaluation
roles.stock_loader: Never use V6 common.load_data. Separate W-only acquisition reader opens W_LABELS only; B-only episode reader opens S/R after common400 freezes; held A artifact is evaluator-only.
roles.tensor_row_order: Increasing node ID within each frozen role; membership follows the exact hash orders above

scope: One prospective representative finite learning-response contrast: new S/R supervision begins after W-only acquisition. Only the common initial state has this exposure boundary; repeated episodes train on S and R. No novelty or acceptance claim.

serving.Brier: FP64 accumulation of squared errors using saved served FP32 pooled probabilities
serving.NLL: Stable FP64 log_softmax/logsumexp of the same fixed arithmetic probability pool from saved native FP32 logits; no epsilon clipping or temperature
serving.accuracy: Native FP32 softmax and FP32 member mean, lowest class index at an argmax tie
serving.disclose: FP32 pooled target zeros and argmax ties, raw-member unanimity and stable NLL are distinct; no NLL-to-raw-error-count inference
serving.pool: Unweighted arithmetic mean of all four softmax class probabilities; no temperature, weights, exclusion or graph postprocessor

unresolved: Native callback/full-forward ownership and higher-order PyG/scatter/global reduction equivalence remain unqualified
Sparse full-native derivatives and whole-process resources/runtime remain unqualified
W-only400 acquisition may have weak competence; one mask/seed/graph is a representative finite test, not a causal V1 comparison
Uniform/epsilon-dominated initial responses and tiny live/stop-Q differences remain interpretable finite outcomes; they do not reject the broad hypothesis
